title: ODNI interested in how Borland tracked search-and-rescue taskers

tellings.quote: know a search and rescue tasker with imagery and sigant when I see it and I know what is our guys and what isn't.

plain: Between 2023 and 2025, the Office of the Director of National Intelligence, which oversees the US spy agencies, and its inspector general took an interest in how Dylan Borland tracked search-and-rescue taskings, he says. Borland, a guest who says a top government official told him aliens run everything, tells Michels he can "know a search and rescue tasker with imagery and sigint when I see it", sigint meaning intercepted signals intelligence. The point of his claim is that he could tell "what is our guys and what isn't", meaning American operations from something else.
